entries.reason: the property iOS 13 added to the synthesizer, carried as a category in AVFoundation/AVSpeechSynthesizer13.m; the header's default is YES, but the host answers NO on a fresh synthesizer, so the port answers NO (the contradiction is written down in facts/AVFoundation/AVSpeech.md)
entries.effect: the value the caller set, NO on a fresh synthesizer as the host answers, held per synthesizer and read back as it was given. 6.1.3 has no such flag: nothing on this release reads it, and whether its speech uses the application's session is stated in facts/AVFoundation/AVSpeech.md
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVFAudio (AVSpeechSynthesis.h); tests/backports/host/avf-speech/synth-checks.m, the host's own class against the port's
